SANDBOX BOUNDARIES

Practice without crossing out.

Your input is evaluated by a small, deterministic teaching model. It is never passed to eval, a script element, an event handler, or a live target.

The preview has an empty sandbox permission list and a CSP that blocks scripts, forms and network requests. Only a fixed, harmless mark element can appear as markup; all learner strings are escaped.

CSP decisions and vulnerable flows are simulations, not a complete browser security engine. Comments, notes and progress live in this browser only. Clearing browser data removes them.
